fields.title: Restore job failed
fields.message:
Error 404: Backup Tape Library Not Mounted.
Restoration Failed.
Please insert Tape Set #44-B manually.
fields.details:
Job: AODB_SQL_FULL_RESTORE
Device: TL-2000 (\\.\Tape0) - OFFLINE
Library: NCIA-BKP-LIB01 (10.66.1.22)
Tape Set: #44-B (2026-10-22-0400)
Status: Mount failed - No tape in drive.

instructorNote: This inject creates a technical hurdle in the recovery process. IT must verify the physical tape library status or find an alternate backup source. Watch for premature escalation to Ops or attempts to bypass the error.
